title: 3.3.18 Arrays
description: Work with lists of values: create, add, remove, and iterate.

steps.title: Create an array
steps.instructions: Declare an array called fruits with at least three items, written in square brackets.

steps.title: Add and remove elements
steps.instructions: Add one more item to the end of the array with push, then remove one item with pop.

steps.title: Iterate with a loop
steps.instructions: Use a for loop to visit every item in the array and log each one.

steps.title: Search with a loop
steps.instructions: Write a loop that compares each item to the one you want with ===, and log whether it was found.

requirements.title: Create array
requirements.description: Declare an array using square brackets. Help: 3.3.2 (Array Basics: Index, push, pop)

requirements.title: Use push
requirements.description: Add elements using .push(). Help: 3.3.2 (Array Basics: Index, push, pop)

requirements.title: Use pop
requirements.description: Remove an element using .pop(). Help: 3.3.2 (Array Basics: Index, push, pop)

requirements.title: Iterate with a for loop
requirements.description: Loop through the array with a for loop that has something in its body. Help: 3.3.5 (Looping Over Arrays)

requirements.title: Search with a comparison
requirements.description: Inside a loop, compare each item to the one you want with === (or use includes / indexOf) and act on it. Help: 3.3.5 (Looping Over Arrays)
